verdict.rationale: Hightouch publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at api.hightouch.io/api/swagger.json covering 36 paths of its public REST API, and its rendered API reference is generated from that same spec. The probe's 404s were only on hightouch.com candidate paths, a different host, so they don't contradict the published spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness, and discoverability at standard well-known paths on the main domain.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
